summary: Implemented every stub in babel/dates.py (timezone lookup, locale name getters, date/time/datetime/skeleton/timedelta/interval formatting, parse_date/parse_time, pattern tokenizing and skeleton matching) and added the missing DateTimeFormat field formatters plus the _localize helper that the tests import. The last full-suite run I saw had 5752 passed, 1109 failed and 6 skipped; within test_dates.py the remaining failures are two zoneinfo cases that need US/Eastern (absent from this container's tz data) and failures from LocaleDataDict.copy being missing in localedata.py, which belongs to another builder.
